articles.title: British Paratroopers Deliver Lifesaving Care to World's Most Remote Island
articles.summary: When a British man on Tristan da Cunha fell ill with suspected hantavirus and oxygen supplies hit critical levels, the UK military launched an unprecedented parachute mission. Medics landed on the island's golf course, bringing 3.3 tonnes of supplies.

articles.title: Evacuation Underway for MV Hondius Passengers After Deadly Hantavirus Outbreak
articles.summary: Passengers from the hantavirus-stricken cruise ship MV Hondius began flying home from Tenerife on Sunday, wearing protective gear. The WHO stressed the public risk is low, but three have died and five are infected with the rare Andes strain.

articles.title: Rayner Issues Stark 'Last Chance' Warning to Starmer After Labour's Election Disaster
articles.summary: Former Deputy PM Angela Rayner says Labour faces its 'last chance' after losing nearly 1,500 council seats and power in Wales. She backed Andy Burnham's return to Westminster, intensifying pressure on Keir Starmer ahead of his reset speech.
